text:
Ava: Starting a contained rollout tomorrow 03:00-04:00 UTC. Components: API v5.1 (pinned), runtime v2.4.0, router v3.3.0, console v1.9.0 behind flag. Stagger: runtime -> router -> console. Confirm routing pins and rollback triggers.

deploy-bot: /deploy canary runtime:v2.4.0 --stages=runtime,router,console --window=03:00-04:00UTC --canary=3% --auto-rollback=true

Diego: runtime v2.4.0 adds improved KV caching and a memory-safety patch. Watch p99 and OOM rates. I ran perf suite; looks fine.

Nina: router v3.3 uses header X-RW-RouteV2. Console will only send it when flag `routeV2`=on for cohort. I'll flip cohort flag if runtime looks healthy.

Ava: Lock API at v5.1 for the window. Keep release notes short: pin info + flag toggle + revert commands.

ops-bot: Preflight OK. Temp dashboard created: /dash/canary-crosssvc. Auto-rollback thresholds: p50+25%, p99+40%, 5xx>1%, errorburn>30%.

deploy-bot: runtime stage started -> deployed to canary ring. Health checks passing. Telemetry enabled.

Diego: runtime smoke: p50/p95 stable, p99 +8%. No OOM. Proceed when you want router stage.

Ava: Proceed to router. Ensure router fallback mapping avoids older runtime variants for canary headers.

Nina: Applied router map prefer-runtime-canary. 92% of canary traces show header. Fallback sends to runtime:stable.

deploy-bot: Router stage done. Console flagged ready but not enabled. Canary at 3% for 18m, no rollbacks.

Ava: If stable at 30m, promote to 25% then 100% per runbook. Any objections?

Diego: No objections. Monitoring p99 closely.

Nina: I'll keep feature-flag toggle handy to revert console header if needed: `flags unset routeV2 --cohort=canary`

Ava: Thanks. Post any metric spikes here with timestamp.
